bank_info_cash: Cash in vault: physical money kept in the safe. Has no bank or number.

purchases_info: How it works: When you buy products outside, you register what you bought, how much, at what price in external currency, and which bank the money came from.
purchases_info_calc: The system automatically calculates the suggested internal price using the FC: internal_price = external_price x FC. This tells you at what price you can sell the product internally.
sales_info: How it works: When you sell products abroad, you register what you sold, how much, at what price in external currency, and which bank the money went to.
sales_info_calc: The received money is automatically added to the selected bank balance when the sale is approved.
fc_desc: The FC indicates how many {{currency}} equals 1 {{currency}}, based on the cost of the basic basket.
fc_default_warning: Default value - press "Edit FC" to configure your community's real value
fc_calc_desc: Compare the cost of the same basic basket (basic foods, essential services) in the external currency and in {{currency}}. The system automatically calculates the FC. You don't need to do calculations: just enter the two prices.
fc_step1_hint: Choose the currency of the country you will trade with. E.g: USD for dollars, COP for Colombian pesos.
fc_step2_basket: 2. Cost of the basic basket there (in {{currency}})
fc_step2_hint: How much a basic food basket costs there in their currency. E.g: if it costs 300 {{currency}} there, enter 300. You can search "basic basket {{currency}}" on the internet.
fc_step3_hint: This value cannot be edited. It is the same in all federation nodes. It can only be changed through a federated proposal approved by consensus. Go to "Federation" to propose or vote on changes.
fc_example_desc: This means that 1 {{currency}} has the same purchasing power as {{currency}} {{currency}}.
fc_about_desc: The FC is an accounting reference, not a speculative exchange rate. The assembly decides it based on the real cost of living.
fc_about_when_desc: when prices change significantly there or here. It doesn't go up or down on its own - an administrator updates it when considered necessary.
fc_about_why_desc: the {{currency}} is not a financial currency. It is a community accounting unit. The FC only serves to know how much something from outside is worth in local terms.
fc_about_who_desc: The Assembly decides in the Configuration tab. It can be: an administrator, the board of directors, an authorized person, or only by assembly vote. In countries with unstable economies (e.g: Venezuela), it's convenient to assign a person who updates frequently. In stable countries, it can be decided by assembly.
operations_type_hint: Defines the direction of the operation. E.g: Import to bring flour from another network.
operations_import_desc: Import: Buy products from outside the network. You pay in local currency ({{currency}}), the seller receives in their currency.
operations_export_desc: Export: Sell products abroad. You receive local currency ({{currency}}), the buyer pays in their currency.
operations_none_hint: Create a new operation with the button above.
calculator_desc: This table shows the price of each node product converted to the external currency using the current FC. It is informative: it helps you compare if the FC calculated from the basic basket is close to the real external price.
calculator_usage_desc: Compare the "External price" with what that product actually costs in the external country. If prices are close, the FC is well calibrated. If they are very different, consider recalculating the FC from the basic basket.
modal_price_unit_label: The price is per unit of:
help_what_desc: External Trade allows buying products from outside the network and selling products abroad. It is the only part of the system that handles REAL money (USD, EUR, COP, etc.).
help_account_desc: External Trade has its own account in {{currency}} (like an organization). The Assembly transfers {{currency}} to it so it can buy outside. To fund the DEX, create a "Fund External Trade" proposal in the Assembly.
help_bank_accounts_desc: The DEX has accounts in real banks or in cash (vault). Each account has a currency (USD, EUR, COP...) and a balance. When buying outside, it's deducted from the bank. When selling outside, it's added to the bank.
help_purchases_desc: It registers what product was bought, how much, at what price in external currency, and which bank the money came from. The system calculates the suggested internal price using the FC.
help_sales_desc: It registers what product was sold, how much, at what price, and which bank the money went to.
help_fc_desc: Relationship between the external currency and the {{currency}}. It is calculated by comparing the cost of the basic basket there and here. After real purchases, the system suggests an FC recalculation based on the real prices paid.
help_board_desc: The DEX may require multi-signature to approve purchases/sales (e.g: 2 signatures). It is configured in the Bank Accounts tab.
tutorial_intro: The DEX is the External Trade department of the community. Its function is to connect the internal economy (TQ) with the external economy (real money: USD, EUR, COP, etc.).
tutorial_flow_1: Internal producer sells to DEX: A community producer sells their product to the External Trade department. The DEX pays them in TQ (internal currency).
tutorial_flow_2: DEX sells abroad (Export): The DEX sells that product in the external market and receives real money (USD, EUR, etc.) in an external bank account.
tutorial_flow_3: DEX buys abroad (Import): With that real money, the DEX buys the products the community needs but doesn't produce (medicines, tools, supplies, etc.).
tutorial_flow_4: DEX sells internally: The DEX brings those products and sells them within the community in TQ. Members can buy them with their internal balance.
tutorial_flow_5: The cycle repeats: The money from internal sales is used to buy more products from producers, and so the cycle continues.
tutorial_double_1: External bank accounts: Reflect the REAL money available (USD, EUR, COP). They update with each external purchase and sale.
tutorial_double_2: DEX TQ balance: Reflects the department's internal debt/credit. When it buys products from a producer, it pays in TQ. When it sells products internally, it receives TQ.
tutorial_fc_desc: The FC is the exchange rate between external currency and TQ. For example, if FC = 5, then 1 USD = 5 TQ. The FC is calculated by comparing the cost of a basic basket in external currency vs in local TQ. The suggested FC is automatically recalculated from registered real purchases.
tutorial_approvals_desc: External purchases and sales may require multiple approval (multi-signature). This means several authorized people must approve before money is moved. This prevents a single person from having total control over real money.
